independence.review_type: Independent pre-execution semantic labeling by a separate agent under fixed dev4 contract
read_inputs: Only saved source files named by the fresh cases, for exact hashes, offsets, and adjacent context
independence.label_basis: Exact case text only; source metadata and surrounding text validate provenance, not reference presence. Case strata are not label authority.
independence.same_model_family_limitation: Separate-agent review is procedural independence, not independent model-family or human expertise evidence; shared model-family biases remain possible.
independence.dataset_separation_limit: Development and retired sets were deliberately not inspected. Separation from those families is not independently established by this report.

source_checks.offset_unit: Unicode character indexes after UTF-8 decoding, as used by experiment.py
source_checks.authored_validation: All 32 nonsource cases are explicitly marked authored and retain their fictional, private, heading, or quoted framing inside focus.

boundary_notes: A source identifier introducing a complete unit (f019) remains an identifier rather than a substantive body pointer. The focus itself establishes its source role.
Fictional authorities are evaluated as explicit textual pointers. No claim of their real-world existence or validity is made.
f027, f029, f031, and f048 have insufficient supplied wording under the uncertainty rule; these are expected uncertainty outcomes, not unresolved reviewer ambiguity.
The public sense of relative references is assessed from the legal regulatory wording in focus without importing surrounding source references.
contract_review.implementation_review: experiment.py sends only case text in state.focus with the fixed question, keeps review labels outside model input, validates source hashes and slices, and requires matching review hashes and no flagged material ambiguity before freeze.
